body:
Second step of the simulation-thread / immutable-Scene renderer revamp (after #522). Everything still runs on one thread; this batch removes the couplings that would become data races or dangling pointers once the simulation runs on its own thread, and starts drawing from an extracted Scene. No simulation, save, replay or network change.

## Changes (one commit each)
1. **Per-view render state off `Game`/`Map`** — `MapRenderState` (owned by `Game::ViewState`) holds the water/cloud phase, area-marker phase, cloud field, software terrain cache and overlay scratch that lived on `Game` or in function statics. `Map::identity()` lets caches notice a replaced map. The building-gradient debug view no longer finishes lazy searches while drawing (unreachable in normal builds).
2. **`SceneBuffer<T>`** — lock-free triple buffer for handing a Scene from the simulation thread to the render thread (unit-tested; concurrent case clean under ThreadSanitizer).
3. **Terrain, resources, fog and areas drawn from `SceneMap`** — an immutable copy of the per-tile layers with `Map`-identical queries. `drawMap` draws `ViewState::scene` when published, else extracts its own, so all callers (game, menu colony, editor, torus, tests) keep working. Whole-layer copy: 0.02–0.1 ms per extraction on desktop (128²–256²), no dirty tracking. The software terrain cache and GPU geometry caches key on the source map identity.
4. **Client channels and selection by reference** (`src/sim/`) — selection holds `BuildingRef`/`UnitRef` (gid + generation) resolved through `Game`; `ClientEvents` carries team events, chat, marks, pause and order effects to the GUI; `ClientCommandSink` replaces scripts writing `GameGUI` directly; `ClientRequests` carries the observed building, and failing-unit recording is applied at the tick boundary. Team event queues are now drained by the simulation into `ClientEvents` (they are neither saved nor read by simulation code).
5. **Hovered unit as a `UnitRef`** instead of a raw `Unit*`.

## Verification (macOS, Apple clang 21)
- `GLOB2_SYNC_RAND_STRICT=1 python3 test/check_sim_thread.py <branch> --baseline <master 75ad507e7>`: new-game ×2, generated map, v121 save, save continuation — identical checksum sidecars, replay bytes, final saves; zero unbound RNG draws. Run after each commit and on the combined branch.
- `run_tests.py --no-display --exclude-tag map-generators`: 344 passed, 0 failed. Unit binary: 90 passed.
- Display tests touching this code (SoftwareRenderer, TorusRender, HighResolution, MapRenderResize, PortableRenderer, FailingUnitMarkers, EnteringUnit, GameGUITouch, GameGUISelection, ScriptEditor): all pass.
- Pixel parity for the SceneMap port: SoftwareRenderBenchmark captures over 3 saves × 3 zooms × gui/map modes are byte-identical to the parent, except one 16×13 region that also differs between two runs of the parent binary.
- New tests: `SceneBuffer`, `ClientChannels`, extended `GameGUISelection`.
- Full local display suite: 7 failures unrelated to this diff — `Settings` layout (6, fullscreen switching asserted without `--fullscreen`) and `MapPreview` fade timing (load average 60+ during the run).
- Rebased onto #530 after verification; rebuilt, unit and targeted engine tests re-run.
- Not verified locally: Linux/Windows/Android/iOS/browser (CI). Known master failures: windows (mingw-w64), linux tests shards 3/4 and 4/4 (SoftwareRenderer blending), Android release-tag contract.

## Feel
Water/cloud animation phase restarts when a game is loaded, and the menu colony no longer shares its cloud field with the game (each view animates independently). Failing-unit markers for a newly selected building start at the next tick boundary (same tick in practice). No other visual or gameplay change intended.
